hero.title: Code. <1>Collaborate.</1> Ship.
hero.description: Everything your team needs to build great software — code hosting, real-time collaboration, team chat, and code review — in one unified platform.

features.title: Everything your team needs
features.subtitle: Self-hosted Git platform with built-in collaboration tools designed for modern development teams.

codeHosting.title: Code Hosting
codeHosting.desc: Self-hosted Git repository hosting with branch protection, webhooks, and fine-grained access control.

teamChat.title: Team Chat
teamChat.desc: Real-time messaging with channels, threads, and rich code snippets. Keep discussions in context.

codeReview.title: Code Review
codeReview.desc: Inline pull request reviews with threaded discussions, approval workflows, and merge checks.

realtimeEditing.title: Real-time Editing
realtimeEditing.desc: Collaborative code editing with live cursors, presence awareness, and CRDT-based conflict resolution.

issueTracking.title: Issue Tracking
issueTracking.desc: Manage issues with labels, milestones, batch operations, and integrations with your Git workflow.

releaseManagement.title: Release Management
releaseManagement.desc: Tag releases, attach assets, publish release notes. Integrated with your repository and webhook system.

collab.title: Real-time collaboration, built in
collab.description: Edit code together with your team just like Google Docs. See who's working on what, discuss in real-time, and never worry about merge conflicts again.
